name: Granja de Torrehermosa (Spain)
description: White field with a green triangle at the lower hoist and a red diagonal band from the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Granja de Torrehermosa (a tower and a cross on white and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Granja de Torrehermosa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper edge to the fly
